question: The book titled 'The Ministry of Utmost Happiness' has been written by _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __Arundhati Roy__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Arundhati Roy is a Political Activist and Writer.
 
• Her debut Novel is the "God of Small Things" has won the Booker Prize in 1997.
 
• The Novel depicts Corruption, Political Violence, and Capitalism.
